ArmnetBench v0.1 contains 12 tabletop tasks, including eight single-arm tasks, and each task-policy combination was trained or fine-tuned using exactly 50 human-teleoperated reference demonstrations. Seven policies were evaluated: ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA, π0, π0.5, GR00T N1.7, and MolmoAct 2. Each task-policy pair targeted 30 rollouts, with one π0 and one π0.5 episode removed because of incorrect manual resets, leaving those pairs with 29 valid episodes. Before each rollout, an operator reset the scene and randomized object placement within a task-specific range; initial states were independently sampled across policies. Operators assigned one of three labels—successful, suboptimal, or failure—through the control panel. v0.1 did not impose standardized wall-clock limits, so termination depended on operator judgment.
